content: Service Name Nv M_ First Init All Syntax void Nv M_ First Init All ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x14 Sync/ Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description The function initiates a multi block first initialization request. The job of the function does not care if a block exists in the non - volatile memory or not OR if it is valid (i.e. not corrupted) or not, when processing it. Available via Nv M.h
